author: Cleo Abram
description:
This crazy machine might help us find aliens.

Right now, it’s hard to find Earth-like planets behind the bright glare of the stars they orbit…

This telescope uses a new machine to uncover them and it’s 100 to 1,000 times more powerful than any other of its kind on a space telescope…

To see what it finds, subscribe!

#NASA #Roman #JWST #telescope #sky #universe
title: Crazy New Machine Helps Us Find Aliens
